parityContract: The one-time P11.5 compatibility bridge remains fail-closed and exact for the authorized cleanup candidate, while unrelated synthetic or future heads cannot activate it unless their own base-to-head changed set includes the CI declaration.

allowedBehaviorDifferences.reason: When the head CI declaration differs from the runner's base-owned package but that declaration is not changed by the current base-to-head comparison, the candidate skips the one-time P11.5 bridge instead of rejecting an unrelated authorization scenario. The exact cleanup candidate still changes the declaration and therefore retains the authorized bridge behavior.
